annotation: The participant managed a half-hearted smile, shifted their gaze to the right, making no eye contact, and clasped their hands in front of them.
The participant looked upward to the right, chuckled with slightly narrowed eyes, and leaned forward a little.
The participant adjusted their posture, leaning forward, furrowed their brow, their eyes focused on the partner.
The participant leaned forward with raised eyebrows and arms extended down their sides.
The participant raised their shoulders, extended their right hand, palm open, and leaned forward.
